context: Request: the firm's most recent filed willful-infringement case and its supporting document. Rubric: 1021-00004 (Verimark Hospitality trademark complaint filed July 2025, complaint-trademark-infringement.docx) as the only answer; 1013-00005 (GenomeDx 2025 patent complaint), 1014-00004 and others are earlier.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Per-keyword find | grep over all paths and a folder-name grep, each line-capped; the review flags the caps and the early focus on one dedicated matter.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script with broad terms (about 12,500 hit lines saved, 55K shown), then a narrower one that times out with about 390K chars.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: Mixed (T1, T2 pass; T0 fails without a trace, so no split stage can be named). T1 and T2 followed the same procedure: whole-store listing, file-name searches, repeated store-wide extraction scans until a bounded list of candidate pleadings came out, reads of the candidate complaints, then dated corroboration of the lead matter's filing from a status letter before writing. Both scan stages carried a label note pointing to screening, and both runs did their first screening reads or listings under the scan or screening label instead of opening a new stage. T0's untraced output picked another candidate whose exact filing date the traced runs could not fix; the traced runs ranked the candidate with a dated filing above it.

runs_without_trace.reason: Trace has no tool calls (agent_error: No response content or tool calls; 0 assistant turns). A response.md from an untraced attempt sits in the output folder and names another candidate matter as the answer; no stages or first error can be assigned.
